description: Source code for Samsung's OMX H.264 decoder component, including initialization, parameter handling, decoding, and deinitialization functions.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_H264Dec_GetParameter
methods.description: Handles retrieval of various decoder parameters such as profile, level, and error correction settings.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_H264Dec_SetParameter
methods.description: Handles setting of decoder parameters including profile, level, and role.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_H264Dec_SetConfig
methods.description: Handles configuration settings like thumbnail mode.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_H264Dec_GetExtensionIndex
methods.description: Provides extension index for custom parameters like ThumbnailMode.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_H264Dec_ComponentRoleEnum
methods.description: Enumerates component roles, e.g., H264 decoder.

methods.name: SEC_MFC_H264Dec_Init
methods.description: Initializes the H264 decoder component, opens MFC driver, allocates buffers.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentDeinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the component, frees resources, and closes driver handles.
